title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. It will be her first full tour of the region since she stepped away from touring in 2025.

The route includes Radio City Music Hall and the Greek Theatre, with two Toronto nights also on the schedule. Those rooms mark a clear change in scale from Young's earlier North American headline dates. The new itinerary arrives after she spent much of 2026 rebuilding her live schedule through festival appearances and UK headline shows.

The title Everything Begins flips one of Young's own tattoos. She has "Everything Ends" tattooed on her body, and the tour name reverses that phrase around the idea of starting again. It gives the announcement a connection to the period she has been writing about in her recent music rather than functioning as a label placed on a list of dates.

Young returned with "From Down Here" after stepping away from touring. She wrote the song with James Blake, and it arrived after "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the Grammy Awards. Since then, she has moved back into regular live work through festivals and UK shows. The Everything Begins announcement turns that gradual return into a full headline plan, with one route carrying the same production and support lineup across the United States and Canada rather than a series of isolated appearances.

[youtube:YFhpMpONGUY]

Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. Sofia and the Antoinettes will support the announced North American dates. The tour gives Young a continuous headline run at a point when her live career is moving into larger rooms, while the new single provides the clearest indication yet of what she will be bringing to those stages beyond the songs that first expanded her audience.
